detail.longDescription: Chrome 158 ships the `focus-without-user-activation` permissions policy. Sites can now block `element.focus()`, `autofocus`, and `window.focus()` in embedded frames without user activation. User-triggered focus is unaffected. Extension devs: content scripts that auto-focus elements in iframes may be silently blocked on sites that adopt this policy. https:// chromestatus.com/release-notes /158 # ChromeExtensions # WebDev # Chrome
